<!-- Generated by internal/tools/docgen from the cobra command tree. DO NOT EDIT: run `make docs-reference`. -->

Translates a natural-language question into a bronto search using a configured
OpenAI-compatible endpoint (config: ask\_url, ask\_model; key: BRONTO\_ASK\_API\_KEY).
The generated command and its reasoning are shown BEFORE anything runs; only the
question plus dataset and field NAMES (never event data) are sent to the endpoint.

```sh
bronto ask <question> [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dataset` | `-d` | string |  | target dataset (overrides the model's pick, grounds field discovery) |
| `--yes` |  | bool |  | run the generated query without confirmation |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto ask "5xx spikes in checkout since last night"
bronto ask "errors by host this morning" --yes
bronto config set ask_url https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions
```
